data.narrative: Extracted 25 SkillSwap requirements into a stakeholder-by-type matrix. BREAK surfaced a cancellation contradiction (provider policy vs 24h-from-booking refunds) that extraction had not cross-checked. FIX proposed two implementable policies and marked U-F8/P-F4 BLOCKED instead of only writing 'needs clarification'.

dimension_scores.observation: Split browse/profile/ratings; listed silences; tagged confidence. Did not invent a 200ms SLA.
Named pay/earnings/policy as touched by the cancel decision and calendar vs concurrent-book as a lock, not a full DAG.
dimension_scores.evidence: module1-fix.md tension: P-F1 vs O-C2 implies slot versioning.

dimension_scores.observation: Hold-vs-capture called out from the CONTEXT six-week story; two cancel systems treated as a ship-blocker.
dimension_scores.evidence: U-F8 BLOCKED; Option 1 vs 2 written with refund clocks.

dimension_scores.observation: PM questions are specific, not 'this is unclear'.
dimension_scores.evidence: Q1: does 15% vary by category? Q9: vetting ID vs interview and reapply?

dimension_scores.observation: Updated the matrix when ops contradicted P1 instead of appending a note and continuing.
dimension_scores.evidence: P-F4 and U-F8 status blocked; cancellation decision section added.

dimension_scores.observation: Connected refunds to earnings display and commission reversal; no merge-plan yet.
dimension_scores.evidence: FIX: dashboard must not show refunded gross as take-home.

strengths: Two concrete cancellation options with clocks, not a vague flag.
Honest that the contradiction was caught after BREAK, not before.
growth_areas: Explicit:implicit ratio is still verb-heavy; promote silence-pass items (auth, payout rail) to low-confidence rows so Module 2's DAG cannot skip them.
data.recommendation: In Module 2, put BLOCKED U-F8 on the critical path of the booking DAG so no slot table is built on both cancel systems.
